content: EARS (Mavin 2009): fixed clause order While <precondition>, When <trigger>, the <system> shall <response>; five patterns Ubiquitous, Event-driven (WHEN), State-driven (WHILE), Unwanted (IF..THEN), Optional (WHERE), plus Complex combinations. Common mistakes: vague terms, passive voice, no system name, multiple responses per line, missing error cases. Kiro popularised EARS in AI specs.
